differs_from_production: Loopback port 18299 instead of 18232; no --api-key-file, CORS or --metrics flags.
No server-level sampling or reasoning defaults: the frozen request sets sampling and disables thinking, and a request's enable_thinking=false overrides --reasoning on.
--cache-ram 0 and request cache_prompt=false, so every filing starts from an empty cache regardless of order.

sampling.scope: The same deterministic non-thinking settings for every arm; not the publishers' recommended sampling. No grammar or response_format, so JSON validity is measured rather than enforced.

task.description: Predict the Form 8-K item codes a filing declares, from the text of its primary document.
task.unit: One accession. Co-filers share one filing and one label set, so n is at most 360.

acquisition.runtime: catalyst-provenance SDK Python with EdgarTools 5.58.0 (the version is checked)
acquisition.http: EdgarTools get_with_retry with the contact as its User-Agent (EDGAR_IDENTITY in the process only) and a private per-run cache (EDGAR_LOCAL_DATA_DIR)
acquisition.rate_control: EDGAR_RATE_LIMIT_PER_SEC=5 before import, plus a local pacer that starts at most five requests per second
acquisition.requests: one daily index, then per accession its .hdr.sgml header (labels) and full submission .txt (document)
acquisition.contact: Read from the file named by the SEC_CONTACT_ENV pointer (--env-file); owner-only regular file; never printed, stored or hashed into outputs
acquisition.retention: ~/.local/state/native-agent-stack/local-inference-latest-20260926/sec/<run-id>/ (0700 directories, 0600 files); manifest.json lists SHA-256, bytes and first observation per file
acquisition.complete_when: the index hash and cohort counts match, no refusal stopped the run, at most 36 acquisition failures, and at least one eligible filing

labels.caveat: Filer-declared header metadata: not hand-checked and not frontier-model labels.

input.document: The first SGML <DOCUMENT> after </SEC-HEADER> whose <TYPE> equals the filing's form (8-K or 8-K/A).
input.header: The whole <SEC-HEADER> block is dropped, including its ITEM INFORMATION lines, which would reveal the labels.
input.html: Tags removed with html.parser; script, style, head, title and ix:header content dropped; block tags become line breaks; plain-text documents lose <PAGE> lines.
input.whitespace: Zero-width characters removed; each line collapsed to single spaces; empty lines dropped.
input.cap_rule: A normalized text longer than 16,000 characters keeps its first 12,000 and last 4,000 characters joined by the marker.
input.cap_justification: C0 has one 8,192-token slot. The frozen prompt is 2,470 characters without the filing (about 700 tokens with the chat template, estimated at 3.5 characters per token) and the output cap is 256 tokens, which leaves about 7,200 tokens. 16,000 characters overflow only below about 2.2 characters per token; English SEC prose runs near 4 with Qwen-family tokenizers and dense numeric tables near 3. The last 4,000 characters keep the closing items (usually 9.01) and the signature block of long documents. A request the server still rejects for length is scored as an invalid output, not excluded.

exclusions.definition: The header or submission request failed, was refused, exceeded its size cap or was not attempted after a refusal stop; or the bytes failed the native header parser, the repository's strict header identity and acceptance check, or the submission identity check; or ITEMS were malformed or repeated.
No document of the filing's form type, or its normalized text is empty.
The native header declares no ITEMS.

task.exclusion_order: The first matching reason in the listed order; every accession gets at most one.
task.n: Every eligible accession of the frozen cohort; all runnable arms score exactly the same filings.

metrics.per_filing: precision tp/(tp+fp), 0 when nothing valid is predicted; recall tp/(tp+fn); F1 2tp/(2tp+fp+fn); exact match when the predicted set equals the declared set
metrics.macro_f1: Mean per-code F1 over the codes declared by at least 5 eligible filings; the code set comes from the labels and is the same for every arm
metrics.json_valid_rate: Share of eligible filings whose whole reply is exactly one JSON object {"items": [...]} of unique code strings
metrics.fenced_json: A reply wrapped in one markdown code fence is scored for F1 but does not count as JSON-valid
metrics.invalid_output: Unparseable, wrong schema, server error or not attempted: the predicted set is empty
metrics.decode_tokens_per_second: timings.predicted_per_second per filing; the median over filings with an HTTP 200 reply and predicted_n >= 1
metrics.ttft_ms: timings.prompt_ms, the prompt processing time before the first generated token
metrics.cold_load_seconds: From starting the server process to its first /health 200
metrics.peak_device_memory: The largest whole-device memory.used in the 1 Hz nvidia-smi samples while the arm's server runs; shared-device observation, not per-process attribution

decision_rule.text: An arm replaces C0 as the production generation model only if (1) the paired bootstrap (10,000 resamples, seed 20260926) 95% lower bound of micro-F1(arm) - micro-F1(C0) is at least -0.02, (2) its median decode tokens/s exceeds C0's, (3) its JSON-valid rate is at least 0.98, and (4) it had no memory or deadline failure. Inference speed alone does not pass. C1 or C2 passing means keep the model and change only the serving profile.

bootstrap.method: Paired percentile bootstrap over filings in accession order: each resample is random.Random(20260926).choices over the filing indices, applied to both arms; micro-F1 is recomputed for each.
bootstrap.lower_bound: Nearest-rank 2.5th percentile: the 250th smallest of the 10,000 differences.

decision_rule.failure_free: No guard event (device reserve, monitor failure, memory limit not verified, startup failure or deadline), no request or arm deadline, no server exit or unavailability, and both the window record and the evaluation completed
decision_rule.control_validity: If C0 is not evaluated or has any failure, no arm replaces it and the result is inconclusive.
decision_rule.selection: Among passing arms the highest median decode tokens/s is selected; ties go to the higher micro-F1, then to plan order.

window.coordination_rule: window.sh refuses to start unless README.md contains that exact line; another session owns GPU trials until it is recorded.
window.untouched: native-stack-embeddings.service and every other unit, Windows applications and WSL distributions (never wsl --terminate or --shutdown; never the Polaris distribution)
window.admission_rule: Whole-device memory.free >= max(16384, estimated_device_mib + 3072) MiB immediately before load, else the arm is recorded as admission-refused.
window.guard: nvidia-smi whole-device memory.free every second; below 3,072 MiB only the arm's own scope is stopped.
window.isolation: systemd-run --user --scope with MemoryMax and MemorySwapMax, verified through systemctl show before the arm counts
window.retention: ~/.local/state/native-agent-stack/local-inference-latest-20260926/runs/<window>/ holds private server logs and raw replies; window-summary.json, window.json, memory.csv, eval/metrics.json and the analysis output carry no document text.

failure_rule: Retain every refused, failed and stopped attempt. No silent retry, no changed profile and no re-run to improve a result. A guard, host-memory, startup or deadline failure ends that arm and fails criterion (4). Changing any frozen value needs a new plan.
claims_excluded: catalyst, incentive or trading-signal value of item codes
isolated benchmark throughput on an unshared device
any result for arms B or X
